title: Контрфактическая точка сравнения
description: Контрфактическая точка сравнения: чтение оригинального текста, контекстный словарь и точное описание ситуации с объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Найти в тексте ответ на вопрос «Что ставила под сомнение критик?»
Различать значения counterfactual и baseline в теме «Контрфактическая точка сравнения»
notes: В предложении «The attribution is dependent on the comparison.» подлежащее в единственном числе согласуется с is.
При чтении важно сохранить факт или границу вывода: «The criticism proves the reminders failed.»

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: «Контрфактическая точка сравнения»: выбери значение слова «counterfactual» в контексте урока.
Вставь слово из пары counterfactual / comparison. Значение: «Приписывание причины зависит от сравнения.»

public_payload.passage: A report credited a new reminder system with reducing missed appointments because the number fell after its introduction. A critical response asked what would probably have happened without the system. The same period included a timetable change and fewer appointments overall. The critic did not deny that reminders might have helped; she challenged the assumption that the observed before-and-after difference measured their effect by itself. A defensible comparison would need to address the alternative changes and the relevant baseline. Rephrasing her objection as proof that reminders had failed would repeat the same mistake in the opposite direction. The response called for a better basis for attribution, while leaving open more than one possible explanation of the observed reduction.

options.label: The fact that any appointments existed.
The possibility that reminders helped at all.
Attributing the whole reduction to reminders from before-and-after counts alone.

exercises.editorial_answer: Attributing the whole reduction to reminders from before-and-after counts alone.
exercises.explanation: Ответ подтверждён текстом: «Attributing the whole reduction to reminders from before-and-after counts alone.». Другие варианты изменяют указанное обстоятельство.
